app.title: Animae session diagnostics
app.intro: Developer console for the WebSocket session: connection health, read-only smoke checks, model call traces, and protocol frames. Nothing here is required to play.
app.introMutate: Only the Console tab sends player input or commands that change game state. Smoke tests and other tabs are read-only.
env.cardIntro: Absolute paths on the host running this session. Values come from the authenticated server hook.
env.unavailable: Environment metadata is not available on this host.
overview.smokeIntro: These tests open a fresh connection (or reuse the current one) and never send turns, saves, or config changes—except set_locale to the already negotiated tag.
smoke.desc.socket_open: Opens the WebSocket within five seconds.
smoke.desc.hello_ok: Completes hello and receives hello_ok with protocol version 1.
smoke.desc.snapshot_shape: Receives a snapshot whose state includes scene, header, actions, panels, and transcript.
smoke.desc.ping_rtt: Measures ping to pong round-trip time (warn above 750 ms, fail above 3 s).
smoke.desc.locale_negotiation: Verifies hello_ok.locales lists the negotiated locale and set_locale to the same tag succeeds.
smoke.desc.config_get_secrets: Ensures config_get does not expose unmasked token-like values.
smoke.desc.llm_log: Fetches llm_log (warns when the host disabled the model call log).
smoke.desc.get_state_version: Compares get_state protocolVersion with the latest snapshot.
smoke.desc.resume_quiet: Reconnects with resumeSeq and expects no stream/busy replay burst while idle.
llm.clearConfirm: Clear the in-memory model call log on the host?
llm.disabled: Model call log is disabled on this host. Enable modelCallLog on the engine to record prompts and responses.
llm.col.label: Label
protocol.title: Live frames
console.warning: Messages sent here can change game state. Available only when you hold the controller seat.
console.notController: Connect as controller to send mutating frames.
